estimator.disagreement: For each of7200given cells in90rows, count the three unordered disagreements among its three query labels. D is total observed disagreements and T=21600 is total comparisons. Independent symmetric incorrect-digit noise implies E[D/T]=f(p)=2p-9p^2/8. The three pair indicators per cell are dependent; do not use an independent-binomial confidence claim or claim inverse-moment unbiasedness.
estimator.branch: Restrict the supplied model class to0<=p<=8/9, where f is increasing and channel accuracy is at least random guessing. If exact empirical D/T>8/9, retain the bank as estimator-unresolved, skip all costs/fits, and include it in both endpoint bounds. No empirical clamping to an admissible disagreement and no retry.
estimator.quantization: Choose nearest assumed rate k/100 with k in1..88 to the lower-branch inverse f^(-1)(D/T), with half-even integer-k ties and endpoint clipping to the positive grid. Implement without numerical square roots: compare D/T exactly to f((2k+1)/200) for each adjacent-rate midpoint, using Python integer cross-products. At an exact boundary choose the even k. Values below first midpoint map to1/100; above last midpoint map to88/100. Record explicit lower/upper clipping indicators by comparisons against f(1/100),f(88/100). This fixed positive floor regularizes zero disagreement and avoids infinite likelihoods; it is part of the estimator.
